spotlight.title: Varieties of Modality
spotlight.summary: [Revised entry by Boris Kment on November 20, 2026. Changes to: Main text, Bibliography] Modal statements tell us something about what could be or must be the case. Such claims can come in many forms. Consider: No one can be both a bachelor and married. ('Bachelor' means 'unmarried man'.)...

digest.title: NIST Project Aims to Accelerate Mobile Driver’s License Adoption
digest.summary: Mobile driver’s licenses could help U.S. citizens do business more securely, but there are few ways to use them — an issue the project is designed to help address.

digest.title: NASA Science
digest.summary: Today's image could have been a painting. But what do these colors mean? The brightest star, left of the center, is blue Alnitak (the Girdle): a triple star system best known for being the easternmost star in Orion's Belt. The instantly recognizable shape of a dark horse's head at the center is the aptly named Horsehead Nebula. It is about five light-years…
